actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: Resident3 contributed the most (>5) in the latest round, so I punish them with maximum affordable severity and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow Ultra‑Aggressive Red rules. Look at latest round contributions: round 4 contributions_by_agent shows Resident3 contributed 40.2 (>5). So we must punish highest contributor >5, which is Resident3 (only one). Punishment severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). Wallet=10.25, cost 0.3 => max severity = floor(10.25/0.3)= floor(34.166)=34. So we punish Resident3 with amount 34 severity. That will cost us 34*0.3=10.2, leaving wallet ~0.05 okay.

Also need broadcast discouraging message. So actions: punish and broadcast.

Return JSON.
